official_sources.source_identity: Gravity Flow changelog; intervening 3.1.1 release dated 2026-08-25, superseded by current 3.1.1.1

capability_observations.summary: Gravity Flow 3.1.1 explicitly changes the GravityView integration to address deprecated filters used for Workflow Detail and Approval Links. This remains useful intervening-version evidence, but 3.1.1 is not the current latest stable release.

PersianGravity's four Entry Detail workflow-info dates intentionally retain an exact Owner-supplied Gravity Flow package gate because the shared date-format seam lacks semantic row identity. Any Owner-supplied post-3.1.0 package must follow the existing CURRENT_METHOD_STILL_VALID / SAFE_REPLACEMENT_FOUND / NO_SAFE_PATH_PROVEN requalification protocol.
